# Hillgate Bike Co-op: notes for workshop volunteers

These notes are for people who come to help on a workshop night for the first time.

## Opening times

The workshop is open on Tuesday and Thursday from 6pm to 9pm and on Saturday from 10am to 2pm. The first volunteer in unlocks the shed and the last one out locks it and puts the key back in the key box.

## How the co-op started

The co-op began in 2011 when three friends fixed up eleven abandoned bikes in a garage on Pell Street. In 2013 we moved into the old bus shed on Canal Row. In 2016 we became a registered co-operative, and in 2019 we passed 400 members. Our first chairperson, Marta Quill, still comes on Saturdays and tells the story of the eleven bikes to anyone who asks.

## Safety

Eye protection must be worn at the grinder and the wire wheel. Nobody under 16 works in the workshop unless an adult from their family is beside them.

## On the night

1. Sign in on the clipboard by the door.
2. Pick a bike from the waiting rack, oldest tag first.
3. Fill in a repair card for each bike and clip it to the handlebars.
4. Put used parts in the red bin and good spare parts in the blue crates.

## Opening times (again)

The workshop is open on Tuesday and Thursday from 6pm to 9pm and on Saturday from 10am to 2pm. The first volunteer in unlocks the shed and the last one out locks it and puts the key back in the key box.
